note: GameShark: $C234 held at $80; bit 7 is the debug no-damage switch the hit code tests before subtracting ($09:5921 BIT 7 / $09:5926 JR NZ), and nothing in the retail game sets it. Mesen, both versions: a new game, west to the first field screens, then 10 bombs dropped at Bomberman's feet with 150 frames on each: the damage routine ($09:58B1) ran 5 times and HP ($C390) never dropped (without a code: 3 hits, 3 drops, dead at the third). Game Genie 189-26A-6EA ($09:5926 JR NZ -> JR): the same test, the same result.

effect: Invincible: hits do no damage (ROM patch)
note: Game Genie: $09:5926 JR NZ -> JR (compare $20), so the HP subtraction is always skipped; the same address and byte in both versions. Mesen, both versions: a new game, west to the first field screens, then 10 bombs dropped at Bomberman's feet with 150 frames on each: the damage routine ($09:58B1) ran 5 times and HP ($C390) never dropped (without a code: 3 hits, 3 drops, dead at the third). The same byte as patches/quest_invincible_<ver>.ips. GameShark 018034C2 (the flag): the same test, the same result.

GameShark: max HP ($CE81) and HP ($CE82) of the save block held at $A0 (a heart is $10; 10 is what the debug start gives). Mesen: a new game with the pair on reaches the field with 10 hearts (in-play max $C38E and HP $C390 = 160), and a bomb at Bomberman's feet leaves HP at 160. No Game Genie form (WRAM).

GameShark: max HP ($CE80) and HP ($CE81) of the save block, which sits one byte lower in the Japanese version, held at $A0. Mesen: a new game with the pair on reaches the field with 10 hearts ($C38E and $C390 = 160), and a bomb at Bomberman's feet leaves HP at 160. No Game Genie form (WRAM).

effect: Boot straight into the test mode (*TEST MODE*: console type, build date, sound test, colour test, character viewer)
note: Game Genie, $17F2: $17 -> $18 (compare $17), the state the boot hands over after the logos ($00:17F1 LD A,$17 -> $C3E1), so the game enters state $18, the test mode, instead of the title. Mesen: the test mode screen shows (TARGET: CGB (COLOR GB), BUILD: 12/24/1998.17:29:48), state $C3E1 = $18.

effect: Boot straight into the test mode (*TEST MODE*: console type, build date, sound test, colour test, character viewer)
note: Game Genie, $17FF: $17 -> $18 (compare $17), the boot's next state, so the game enters state $18, the test mode, instead of the title. Mesen: the test mode screen shows (BUILD: 10/27/1998.19:56:87), state $C3E1 = $18.

effect: Keeps the debug flag on: Select on the title menu opens the test mode, and Down + Select + A on New Game starts the debug game (10 hearts, every weapon, equipment and item)
note: Game Genie, $19BC: AND $FE -> AND $FF. The boot screen sets $C234 bit 0 ($00:194A) and the next state clears it ($00:19B8), so in retail it is on for one frame. Kept on: the title menu's Select handler ($08:4328) goes to state $18, the test mode; holding Down + Select + A when New Game is chosen sets bit 1 ($08:42BB), and with bits 0 and 1 the new game copies the debug template ($3E:4324) instead of the normal one ($3E:4240, $00:0B60). Mesen: Select on the menu gives state $18; the debug start has max HP and HP 160 and all three bag pages full. Without the code: Select does nothing and Down + Select + A starts a normal game (3 hearts). GameShark 010134C2 ($C234 = 1 each frame): the same results.
